title: Customer Relief Terms Where the Promised Date Has Passed
content:
# Customer Relief Terms Where the Promised Date Has Passed

Where a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions is closed at the customer's request and the piece stands past the date it was promised for, the sum reached is taken at a relief fraction.

## The fractions

1. Where the piece stands past the date it was promised for by more than the studio's overdue days, which are 45 calendar days, and has not been recorded as finished, the sum reached is taken at the studio's overdue relief fraction, which is 0.6.
2. Where the piece stands past the date it was promised for by not more than 45 calendar days and has not been recorded as finished, it is taken at the studio's late relief fraction, which is 0.85.
3. Otherwise the sum reached stands as it is.

## How the days are read

The days are counted from the date the finished piece is promised for, as it stands on the commission, to the day the closure is settled. A piece that has not yet reached the date it was promised for does not stand past it, and the sum reached stands as it is. The piece has been recorded as finished where the date production finished stands on the commission; where it does, the sum reached stands as it is however long the promised date has passed.

## A day-count reading (hypothetical)

A commission promised for the 1st of May, with no date of production finishing standing on it, on a sum reached of USD 4000.00.

| Closure settled | Days past the promised date | Fraction | Sum |
|---|---|---|---|
| The 20th of April | The date has not been reached | The sum reached stands as it is | USD 4000.00 |
| The 10th of May | 9 | 0.85 | USD 3400.00 |
| The 15th of June | 45 | 0.85 | USD 3400.00 |
| The 16th of June | 46 | 0.6 | USD 2400.00 |
